subject: Request: Limited-share penetration findings + SOC2 evidence escrow proposal
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme-payments.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-payments.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:34 -0700
Subject: Request: full pen test report for SOC 2 audit and SIG/CAIQ evidence

Hi Kimberly / Marissa,

Hope you’re both well. Acme’s auditor (Brightline LLP) is asking for the penetration test report and supporting evidence as part of our upcoming SOC 2 readiness assessment. To be clear on scope: they need a vulnerability inventory (CVE-level), remediation status and dates, and an executive summary showing high/critical findings and remediations.

Our preference is to receive the report directly (unredacted) under our standard mutual NDA. If that’s not possible, please let us know the minimal evidence bundle you can provide that will satisfy Brightline and our internal risk team.

Can you also confirm whether you accept a DocuSign NDA (I can send) and whether you support time-limited secure access (S3 or evidence-escrow) to download artifacts?

We’re hoping to close this by Aug 20 to keep the audit timeline. Please advise on what’s feasible and any gating issues. Happy to set up a 30-minute sync with our security engineer if helpful.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Senior Security Program Manager
Acme Payments, Inc.
alex.turner@acme-payments.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:03:02 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: full pen test report for SOC 2 audit and SIG/CAIQ evidence

Alex —

Thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Short answer: we cannot share the unredacted penetration test report publicly due to contractual obligations with our third-party assessor and sensitive customer data contained in evidence artifacts. That said, we routinely support SOC 2 and SIG audits through two established paths:

1) Redacted executive summary + vulnerability inventory (CVE list without customer-identifying evidence) and remediation timeline; or
2) Full vulnerability evidence bundle provided via a time-limited, access-controlled escrow (encrypted S3 with short-lived credentials) to your auditor/legal under a mutual NDA and access terms.

We’ve attached a redaction_matrix_v1.xlsx that outlines what we redact (IP addresses, customer-specific hostnames, PII in screenshots) and what we can release. We can also provide a heavily redacted exec summary (PDF) right away; full evidence via escrow typically takes 2–3 business days to provision once NDA is signed.

Karthik — I’m looping you in for legal/Proc questions related to our NDA and access terms.

Proposed next steps: I can send a DocuSign NDA (or accept your DocuSign if you send) and schedule a 30-min call with Marissa to walk Brightline through the redacted artifacts. Does Aug 13 or 14 work for a quick sync?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme-payments.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-payments.com, security.team@acme-payments.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:20:10 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: full pen test report for SOC 2 audit and SIG/CAIQ evidence

Kimberly —

Thanks for the quick reply and the redaction matrix. A few clarifying points from our auditor: Brightline needs either (A) the full report under NDA or (B) confirmation that the redacted artifacts contain sufficient technical detail (CVE IDs, proof-of-concept notes, exploitability, and remediation timestamps).

If you go the escrow route, they prefer the evidence be accessible directly by the auditor (not routed through the vendor) and for the access to be auditable (access logs). Can you confirm your escrow provider supports auditor-level accounts and provides access logs?

Procurement will sign an NDA if sent via DocuSign. If you can get the exec summary and CVE inventory to us by EOD Aug 12, that will keep our audit on track; the evidence escrow can be provisioned afterward for Brightline’s review.

We’d also like to schedule a 30-minute call on Aug 13 at 10:00 PT with Marissa; please confirm.

Alex
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:15:27 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: full pen test report for SOC 2 audit and SIG/CAIQ evidence

Alex —

Appreciate the specificity — happy to align with Brightline’s expectations. Quick notes on what we can provide and how: 

- Exec summary: a 2–3 page redacted PDF identifying scope, testing methodology, high/critical findings, and remediation status. This will include CVE IDs and a short PoC description per finding but will redact host-specific logs/screenshots.
- CVE inventory: full list of identified CVEs with severity, discovery date, remediation status, and remediation date (where applicable).
- Evidence escrow: we partner with SecureEvidence for auditor access. Their workflow supports auditor-specific authentication, per-file access logs, and time-limited download tokens. We can provide auditor accounts with read-only access and generate an access log snapshot for your records.

Gating items: we need a mutual NDA signed that allows sharing of third-party assessment findings and clarifies non-disclosure of customer-identifying details. Our legal team will need to review your procurement NDA if you send it; otherwise I’m attaching our standard redaction matrix (redaction_matrix_v1.xlsx) to show the scope of sanitization.

On timing: if NDA is executed today (or you accept our DocuSign), we can share the redacted exec summary + CVE inventory by EOD Aug 12 and provision SecureEvidence access within 48 hours.

I’ll be on the Aug 13, 10:00 PT call to walk through the artifacts with Brightline. Please include the auditor dial-in info in the calendar invite.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme-payments.com>, procurement@acme-payments.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:03:09 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: full pen test report for SOC 2 audit and SIG/CAIQ evidence

Alex / Procurement team —

Confirming we’re good to proceed. I’ve sent our mutual NDA via DocuSign (link: https://docusign.example.com/ACME-KP-NDA-0001) — please have procurement sign and return. Once signed we will:

- Send redacted exec summary (exec_summary_draft_v0.3.pdf) and CVE inventory by EOD tomorrow;
- Provision SecureEvidence auditor access and share the secure S3 link (short-lived credentials) within 48 hours of NDA execution;
- Provide access logs export for your auditor upon request.

I’ll also schedule the Aug 13, 10:00 PT call and include Brightline’s dial-in on the calendar. Thanks for the fast turnaround on your side.

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
